title: Product Management Executive
company: SLTL Group - Sahajanand Laser Technology Ltd
description:
Hello Sir/Ma'am,

Greetings from SLTL Group!!

**About SLTL Group**

SLTL Group is a leading global player in laser solutions, driving innovation across industries with advanced technology and automation. We thrive on creativity, technical excellence, and continuous evolution.

Website: http://www.sltl.com/

**Job Overview**

Product Management Team (PMT) – SLTL Medical Division

We are looking for a Product Management professional to manage medical device products, understand market and customer requirements, and coordinate with cross-functional teams for product development, positioning, and growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage assigned medical device products throughout their lifecycle.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer requirement analysis.
* Coordinate with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Sales, and Clinical/Application teams.
* Support new product development, product improvements, launches, and lifecycle management.
* Prepare product specifications, presentations, technical documents, and product literature.
* Gather market/customer feedback and identify opportunities for product enhancement.
* Support Sales and Marketing teams with product knowledge, positioning, and technical inputs.
* Monitor product performance, market trends, and business opportunities.

title: ERP Head / Technical Lead – University ERP & Digital Platforms
description:
**Experience:**
5–6+ years relevant experience

**Team Leadership:**
Experience leading a 10–15+ member multidisciplinary technology team

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Qualification:**
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.

**Role Overview**

The ERP Head / Technical Lead will own the end-to-end technology, development, delivery and operations of the University’s ERP and associated digital platforms.

The role combines technology leadership, product ownership, full-stack architecture, DevOps, stakeholder management, quality assurance, integrations and user enablement. The candidate will act as the key bridge between University management, academic/educational institutional processes, and the technology team, while maintaining sufficient technical depth to review architecture, code, infrastructure and production releases.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Frontend, Backend, QA, Functional Support and Training teams; plan priorities, sprints, resources and delivery timelines.
* Engage with University management, department heads, colleges, academic/educational stakeholders and administrative teams to understand requirements, processes and operational challenges.
* Translate institutional, academic and administrative requirements into functional specifications, technical roadmaps and actionable development plans.
* Own the complete ERP product lifecycle—requirement, design, development, testing, deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate frontend/backend development, integrations and dependencies to ensure timely and functionally complete delivery.
* Establish strong QA, testing, release and production-readiness processes, including review of critical changes before deployment.
* Oversee DevOps and infrastructure including CI/CD, Linux/server environments, databases, backups, load balancing, storage, monitoring, scalability and production reliability.
* Oversee integrations with payment gateways, biometric devices, communication platforms, APIs and other third-party systems.
* Drive ERP training, user on boarding, documentation, feedback and support to ensure effective adoption across departments and colleges.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, new modules, process simplification, performance enhancement and improved user experience.
* Support technology procurement, vendor evaluation and infrastructure planning when required.
* Oversee technology development and maintenance of University websites, college portals and associated digital platforms.

**Technology & Platform Landscape:**

The role will oversee a multi-platform technology ecosystem serving academic and educational institutions, including:

* **Application Stack:**
  Centralized Python/Django backend, Next.js web applications and Flutter mobile application.
* **DevOps & Environments:**
  Staging and production environments, Jenkins-based CI/CD, release and deployment management.
* **Infrastructure:**
  MinIO object storage, database clustering with ProxySQL, multiple backend instances and load-balanced architecture.
* **Integrations:**
  Biometric devices, payment gateways, IVR/SIP, WhatsApp Business (WABA), email services, ID-card printing systems and planned POS integrations.
* **Digital Platforms:**
  Student, Admission, Careers and Admin/Employee Portals; Performance & Appraisal, Events, Lead Management and other academic/administrative ERP modules.
* **Extended Scope:**
  University website, college sub-websites, new ERP modules, integrations and emerging digital services.

**Required Technical & Leadership Competencies**

* 5–6+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, ERP/product development, technology delivery or enterprise digital platforms, preferably within academic/educational institutions, universities, colleges or other complex institutional environments.
* Proven experience leading a 10–15+ member multidisciplinary technology team.
* Strong full-stack architecture understanding with hands-on exposure to Python/Django, React/Next.js, REST APIs and relational databases.
* Working knowledge of mobile application architecture, with Flutter experience preferred.
* Strong practical understanding of CI/CD, Jenkins, Linux, deployment, load balancing, object storage, database clustering/proxying, monitoring and production troubleshooting.
* Ability to review and challenge system architecture, code, technical designs and infrastructure decisions and drive scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Experience managing third-party/API integrations, particularly payments, communication platforms and devices.
* Strong product ownership, project execution, prioritization and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to translate management objectives, academic requirements and institutional processes into clear technical roadmaps and measurable deliverables.
* Experience with University/Education ERP or complex multi-department academic/educational platforms will be highly desirable.

**Leadership Expectations:**

The successful candidate should be:

* Technically hands-on enough to review designs, diagnose critical issues and make informed architecture and release decisions.
* Comfortable working directly with management, academic leaders, department heads, administrative teams and end users.
* Capable of balancing new development, live-system operations, support, training, security and system stability.
* Focused on building a strong internal team through documentation, knowledge transfer and structured training.
* Able to establish clear ownership, quality standards, release discipline and measurable delivery practices.

**Success in the Role**

Success will be measured by:

* **Predictable and timely delivery**
  of ERP modules and enhancements.
* **Stable, secure and scalable**
  production and staging environments.
* Improved
  **software quality and reduction in production issues**
  .
* Strong alignment between
  **management priorities, academic/educational processes and technology execution**
  .
* High levels of
  **user adoption, training effectiveness and support responsiveness**
  .
* Continuous strengthening of the
  **technology team, architecture and digital capabilities**
  .

title: N+ Product Manager – Content
description:
**Role Overview**
 N\+ is seeking a Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and optimization of its certification\-aligned learning portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying market opportunities, defining learning products, launching new certification pathways, and improving learner outcomes across AI, Microsoft, Cloud, Data, Cybersecurity, and emerging technology domains.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines product management expertise with a strong understanding of professional learning, certification ecosystems, workforce upskilling trends, and instructional design principles. The focus is on creating high\-impact learning experiences that drive learner engagement, course completion, certification success, and business growth.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Product Strategy \& Portfolio Management
   

  

* Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle of learning products from ideation through retirement.
* Build and execute a certification and learning portfolio roadmap aligned with market demand.
* Identify emerging technology trends, skills gaps, and certification opportunities.
* Define learning pathways for AI, Microsoft, Cloud, Data, Cybersecurity, and professional skills.
* Prioritize new course launches based on learner demand, business goals, and competitive analysis


 Learning Product Development
   

  

* Partner with SMEs, instructional designers, trainers, content creators, and certification bodies.
* Translate industry certifications into structured learning journeys.
* Define course scope, learning outcomes, assessments, labs, projects, and credentialing requirements.
* Ensure content quality, relevance, and alignment with certification objectives.
* Manage course refresh cycles to maintain accuracy and industry relevance.


 Market Research \& Competitive Intelligence
   

  

* Monitor certification ecosystems including Microsoft, AI CERTs, and other industry credential providers.
* Conduct learner research and employer interviews to identify evolving workforce needs.
* Analyze competitor offerings, pricing models, and learning experiences.
* Recommend new programs, specialization tracks, and skill pathways.


 Learner Experience Optimization
   

  

* Drive improvements in learner engagement, completion rates, certification pass rates, and customer satisfaction.
* Use learner analytics to identify drop\-off points and optimization opportunities.
* Collaborate with UX, content, and growth teams to improve learning effectiveness.
* Define personalized learning recommendations and role\-based learning journeys.


 Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Collaborate with internal leadership, content teams, external instructors, certification partners, and enterprise customers.
* Communicate roadmap priorities, launch plans, and performance insights.
* Balance learner needs, business objectives, and operational constraints.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Education, Technology, Product Management, or related field.
* 4\+ years of Product Management experience.
* 2\+ years in EdTech, Learning \& Development, Certification, Professional Training, or Workforce Learning.
* Experience building learning products, certification programs, or digital learning experiences.
* Strong understanding of AI, Cloud, Microsoft, Data, Cybersecurity, or professional skills training markets.
* Experience using learner analytics and data\-driven decision making.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Product management certification.
* Familiarity with instructional design frameworks (ADDIE, Bloom’s Taxonomy, Kirkpatrick Model).
* Experience in subscription\-based learning businesses.
* Knowledge of enterprise upskilling and reskilling programs.

title: Project/Product Manager
description:
**Role Overview**
 We’re looking for a Project/Product Manager to drive coordination across internal teams and external partners, with a strong focus on requirement gathering, documentation, and follow\-through. You’ll be the connective tissue between stakeholders — translating requirements into clear documentation, keeping initiatives moving, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Gather and document requirements from internal and external stakeholders
* Write clear PRDs and user stories that engineering can act on
* Groom the backlog and support sprint planning using Agile/Scrum practices
* Coordinate partner and API integrations, working closely with technical teams
* Track project status, manage follow\-ups, and proactively flag risks or blockers
* Lead and coordinate UAT cycles with internal and external stakeholders
* Maintain thorough documentation of requirements, decisions, and workflows
* Manage day\-to\-day communication with internal teams and external partners/vendors
* Review analytics data (Mixpanel/Google Analytics) to inform prioritization discussions
* Review wireframes and design flows in Figma to ensure alignment with requirements
* Maintain project tracking and reporting using Jira, Confluence, ClickUp, or Asana


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or related field; equivalent practical experience is welcome.

title: Team Leader
description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
   

  

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well\-being.
   

  

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi\-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
   

  

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview**
 As part of Global Ops Change Group, the incumbent will be an integral part of a multi\-disciplinary team whose mandate will be to deliver industry leading Front\-to\-Back process and technology solutions. Acting as a change agent, he/she will manage a variety of value\-driven initiatives at every phase of the project life cycle. Use his/her knowledge of processes and best practices within technology (application integration / application development), Finance/Middle\-Office Operations and project management to assist in identification, assessment, and resolution of complex issues/problems.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Assist in executing the enterprise\-wide direction for GBAM Ops functions. As a member in the group, he/she will support front\-to\-back integration and change initiatives and be accountable for driving change and executing successful implementations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a member of DROM Transformation and Change Management team within Global Operations responsibilities will include the following:
   

  

 Candidate will have to liaise with relevant stakeholders (Business, Legal, Compliance, Operations \& Technology etc.) to analyze and decipher key Business requirements and assist in driving the End\-to\-End Project plan
   

  

 Help with defining project scope and perform change assessment
   

  

 Will be expected to prepare BRD, Business scenarios, Traceability matrix, Run books and other key project artefacts at various stages of the project life cycle
   

  

 He/she should be able to manage or assure any risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies that can impact the Go\-live
   

  

 Candidate will have the opportunity to plan \& manage end to end project/ UAT on behalf of Operations for medium to large sized projects
   

  

 Will be expected to create UAT plan, define test approach, co\-ordinate environment readiness discussions with technology teams, drive defect management and UAT governance routines
   

  

 Manage and execute deliverables specific to the region as well as Global deliverables, with reporting both locally and into the Global Program.
   

  

 Communication skills will be heavily utilized in forming and communicating a change agenda and gaining stakeholder buy\-in
   

  

 Help with ensuring Global Change Standards, Enterprise Procedures are followed for the project and that documentation meets Enterprise and line of business requirements.
   

  

 Help with managing project scope, timeline, and budget.
   

  

 Help with managing production of meeting decks and tracking meeting minutes and actions
   

  

 Help with managing RAID logs and follow up on open issues
   

  

 Ability to run testing calls, pick up issues and manage status reporting around defects.
   

  

 Experience of producing test metrics/MI for senior management
   

  

**Requirements**
**Education:** 
 Post\-graduate preferred
   

  

**Certifications If any** 
 : NA
   

  

**Experience Range** 
 : 3\-5 years
   

  

**Foundational skills:**
 A strong change management or transaction reporting experience is required, including the ability to prioritize work and meet deadlines and work in a highly matrixed organization
   

  

 Preference to candidates having prior experience in handling initiatives within regulatory/global markets space
   

  

 Strong verbal and written communication/presentation skills
   

  

 Eye for detail\- Ability to perform detailed requirements analysis and impact assessment across products/process/systems
   

  

 Experience of using appropriate tools and techniques to ensure efficient and effective requirements analysis, project/UAT status reporting and updates.
   

  

 Experience of the products and processes within Global Banking and Markets (FICC, Equities, Derivatives, FX \& Vanilla products, Asset services etc.) in a Global Bank or a consulting firm
   

  

 Familiarization with global regulatory frameworks and corresponding jurisdictional reporting obligations
   

  

 Ability to engage with key project resources and ensure project artefacts are updated
   

  

 Strong end to end Project/UAT management skills, including the ability to prioritize work and meet deadlines and work in a highly matrixed organization. Construct detailed work plans, manage teams, achieve milestones, and communicate the result across a stakeholder audience
   

  

 Deep understanding of the SDLC framework and the various testing cycles
   

  

 Ability to understand and drive Front\-to\-Back Workflow and articulate and understand full product/trade life cycle in Global Markets.
   

  

 Project lifecycle management/tracking and RAID reporting
   

  

**Desired skills:**
 Negotiation Skills: \- Ability to negotiate with ground level folks and with Line managers (Senior \& Junior)
   

  

 Stake holder management (internal \& external) across regions / functions / lines of business.
   

  

 Hands on experience with JIRA, HP\-QC, SQL / Excel VBA, MS access and Share point, and handling MIS, will be an added advantage.
   

  

**Work Timings:** 
 12:30 PM \-09:30 PM IST
   

  

**Job Location:** 
 GIFT/ HYD
